environment.description: Same application deployed behind an AWS Application Load Balancer with a custom HTTPS listener on port 443. The ALB target group forwards to the application on port 3000. The ALB listener is configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) verification mode set to 'strict' using a trust store containing only the organization's internal CA certificate (arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:trust-store/ts-org-internal-ca). Clients must present a valid X.509 certificate signed by this CA to establish a TLS connection. The EC2 security group only allows inbound traffic from the ALB's security group on port 3000. The ALB security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0 but the mTLS handshake rejects connections without a valid client certificate before any HTTP request is processed. Additionally, the instance metadata service uses IMDSv2 with a hop limit of 1.

config.network: Private subnet, no direct internet access to application port
